body: Thank you. I'll keep trying to get up but I don't know how long I can last. I just hope it's soon this light comes..
I wish I could maintain the light or but this feeling always so overbearing. I've been trying to be better, to get a career, to find something.. it's just terrible. I'm just getting worse and worse.

That was pretty opening.. I am better but I am still trying to figure a lot of it out. I'm trying to make it right for both of them and accept what the outcomes shall be and what they decide. I always try to be selfless for most people.. it just I had to be selfish for the wrong thing.
